title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 31: the words king Lemuel's mother taught him, judging righteously, and the worthy woman whose price is far above rubies.

questions.text: Who taught king Lemuel the words of this chapter?
questions.explanation: The first verse says these are the words of king Lemuel, the revelation which his mother taught him.

questions.text: What does Lemuel's mother say is not for kings to drink?
questions.explanation: She says it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, 'Where is strong drink?'

questions.text: To whom should strong drink be given, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The text says to give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

answers.text: To the elders in the gates
To him who is ready to perish

questions.text: For whom is the king told to open his mouth?
questions.explanation: The text says: open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate, and judge righteously.

questions.text: What is the worthy woman's price far above?
questions.explanation: The verse asks who can find a worthy woman, for her price is far above rubies.

questions.text: What is the worthy woman compared to because she brings her bread from afar?
questions.explanation: The verse says she is like the merchant ships; she brings her bread from afar.

questions.text: What does the worthy woman do after she considers a field?
questions.explanation: The verse says she considers a field and buys it, and with the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.

answers.text: She asks her husband about it
She sells it to a merchant

questions.text: Where is the worthy woman's husband respected?
questions.explanation: The verse says her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

answers.text: In the palace of the king
In the house of the merchants
In the gates, among the elders

questions.text: What do the worthy woman's children do when they rise up?
questions.explanation: The verse says her children rise up and call her blessed, and her husband also praises her.

answers.text: They go out to the field

questions.text: According to this chapter, which woman shall be praised?
questions.explanation: The verse says charm is deceitful and beauty is vain, but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
